Summary The Senior Specialist, Networking & Connectivity is responsible for the strategy, design, implementation, operation, and lifecycle management of all networking and connectivity infrastructure across the AI Fabric portfolio of AI-focused data centres. This role provides technical leadership for facility networking, inter-site connectivity, customer cross-connects, carrier relationships, and integration with Bell's national fibre network. review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About The Role We’re hiring Infrastructure Engineers to build the platform every ElevenLabs team ships on. From the GPU clusters that train and serve our models to the cloud platform our product teams build on, you’ll own the infrastructure that millions of users and thousands of businesses depend on. You’ll work directly with research, product, security and safety engineers to launch new infrastructure, scale it as their needs grow, and lead the migrations and platform improvements that make it more reliable, secure and cost-efficient. Run and scale Kubernetes clusters, including GPU clusters for inference and training, across cloud and on-prem. Set up compute, networking, permissions and access for other teams as they grow. Host and operate the data systems product teams depend on. Build the tooling, automations and services that make infrastructure self-serve for the rest of the company, mainly in Python. Take on large efforts, such as cluster builds and cloud migrations, and see them through end to end. We’re a flat team, so you’ll be hands-on from day one. You have strong opinions about doing things right, and you can still move fast when parts of the stack aren’t perfect. Requirements Deep, hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production at scale. Strong experience with GCP, including designing, building and migrating cloud infrastructure end to end as an individual contributor. Strong Python skills and a habit of solving infrastructure problems with code and automation. Experience operating stateful systems (databases, Kafka) on behalf of other engineering teams. Solid fundamentals in infrastructure as code, security and permissions, and the pragmatism to prioritise what matters in a fast-moving environment. Bonus: experience with GPU clusters or ML training/inference infrastructure (e.g. vLLM), on-prem/bare-metal or deep networking experience, or open-source contributions in the cloud-native community. Location This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

You’ll combine all your talents, from leadership, relationship building and delivering technical solutions to our clients as part of our Microsoft 365 Centre of Excellence across Australia! The Microsoft 365 Specialist plays a key role as the technical escalation point of our Microsoft 365 Centre of Excellence. As a Microsoft 365 Specialist, you will be accountable for delivering a first-class experience for consumers of our Modern Workplace services including guiding our business and Customers towards adoption and continuous improvement with the Microsoft 365 stack. Focusing on Microsoft 365 enablement and productivity outcomes for our customers including workloads spanning data, files, communications and collaboration, security and identity and access management This role is available across our Australian Offices: Sydney, Adelaide, Brisbane and Melbourne . Australian Citizenship is required to be eligible for NV1 Clearance . What You’ll Do As the Microsoft 365 Specialist you will typically have exposure across a wide variety of technology areas including (but not limited to): Microsoft identity management (AzureAD, AD Connect, ADFS and Microsoft Identity Manager) Modern business collaboration tools in the Office 365 suite – Teams, Planner, Groups, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Yammer etc. Collaboration and video conferencing solutions like Teams, and ancillary systems like Poly, Cisco and Zoom Working knowledge of competitor solutions in the above IT platforms Email security and archive technologies (Office 365 ATP/EOP, Mimecast, Avepoint). What You’ll Bring Please note that you must be an Australian Citizen to be successful in your application for this role. You will have previous experience in an ICT Professional Services organisation and have extensive hands-on experience as a Microsoft 365 Engineer. You will be able to demonstrate; Extensive knowledge of core collaboration services in Office 365 including: Exchange Online Mailbox Management Exchange Online Protection Microsoft Teams SharePoint Online OneDrive for Business Extensive knowledge of core AzureAD identity management and related objects including: Users Traditional Groups (Security, Distribution) Office 365 Groups Devices Guest Users (External Users) Working knowledge of AzureAD identity and authentication technologies including: Azure AD Connect Password Hash Sync Pass-thru Authentication Seamless SSO ADFS Azure MFA SSPR Culture And Benefits Join a team where you'll be supported to grow your career, prioritise your wellbeing, and make a genuine impact. Whether we're supporting governments, enterprise organisations, or growing businesses, we're committed to creating meaningful outcomes for our customers, communities, and each other. About The Role (your Why) This is a chance to make your mark in a business with strong people and customer focus. You’ll combine all your talents, from leadership, relationship building and delivering technical solutions to our clients as part of our Microsoft 365 Centre of Excellence across Australia! The Microsoft 365 Specialist plays a key role as the technical escalation point of our Microsoft 365 Centre of Excellence. As a Microsoft 365 Specialist, you will be accountable for delivering a first-class experience for consumers of our Modern Workplace services including guiding our business and Customers towards adoption and continuous improvement with the Microsoft 365 stack. Focusing on Microsoft 365 enablement and productivity outcomes for our customers including workloads spanning data, files, communications and collaboration, security and identity and access management This role is available across our Australian Offices: Sydney, Adelaide, Brisbane and Melbourne . Australian Citizenship is required to be eligible for NV1 Clearance . What You’ll Do As the Microsoft 365 Specialist you will typically have exposure across a wide variety of technology areas including (but not limited to): Microsoft identity management (AzureAD, AD Connect, ADFS and Microsoft Identity Manager) Modern business collaboration tools in the Office 365 suite – Teams, Planner, Groups, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Yammer etc. Collaboration and video conferencing solutions like Teams, and ancillary systems like Poly, Cisco and Zoom Working knowledge of competitor solutions in the above IT platforms Email security and archive technologies (Office 365 ATP/EOP, Mimecast, Avepoint). What You’ll Bring Please note that you must be an Australian Citizen to be successful in your application for this role. You will have previous experience in an ICT Professional Services organisation and have extensive hands-on experience as a Microsoft 365 Engineer. You will be able to demonstrate; Extensive knowledge of core collaboration services in Office 365 including: Exchange Online Mailbox Management Exchange Online Protection Microsoft Teams SharePoint Online OneDrive for Business Extensive knowledge of core AzureAD identity management and related objects including: Users Traditional Groups (Security, Distribution) Office 365 Groups Devices Guest Users (External Users) Working knowledge of AzureAD identity and authentication technologies including: Azure AD Connect Password Hash Sync Pass-thru Authentication Seamless SSO ADFS Azure MFA SSPR Culture And Benefits Join a team where you'll be supported to grow your career, prioritise your wellbeing, and make a genuine impact. From industry-leading learning and development opportunities to parental leave, wellbeing support, and employee benefits, we're committed to helping our people thrive both professionally and personally. We're passionate about creating a workplace where people feel supported, empowered, and inspired to do their best work. Whether you're developing new skills, tackling complex challenges, or collaborating with some of the best minds in the industry, you'll be part of a team that values curiosity, innovation, inclusion, and making a genuine difference. Why you will love working here Paid parental leave 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme (DataCare) Ongoing learning, certifications, and career development opportunities Access to industry-leading learning platforms and future skills training Recognition programmes that celebrate great work Great employee discounts and financial wellbeing benefits Meaningful work that makes a real impact
